turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I stopped running two months ago, and I used to run ten kilometres every Saturday morning.
How did that feel for you?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment. Yes, it was like that.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today.
Tell me more about that.
My boss Peterson sends emails at eleven at night and expects an answer before breakfast.
What went through your mind then?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. I think so, yes.
What happened next?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy.
How did that feel for you?
I woke at three again every night this week and just stare at the ceiling.
How did that feel for you?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. I think so, yes.
And how was that for you?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I am afraid the company will let me go in the spring restructuring.
Tell me more about that.
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. It is not easy to talk about.
Let us stop here for today.
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
